text:
### Our Liability
FirstUK Bank is liable for:
- Unauthorized transactions you report within 120 days
- If you followed reasonable security measures
- Up to account balance  
FirstUK Bank is NOT liable for:
- Transactions you authorized (even if regretted)
- Gross negligence (shared password, written PIN)
- Fraud you failed to report for >120 days
name: Chunk 45/61

raw_entities.name: Unauthorized Transaction Liability
raw_entities.description: FirstUK Bank's liability framework for unauthorized transactions reported within 120 days, conditional on customer following reasonable security measures, with liability capped at account balance.
context: FirstUK Bank is liable for: Unauthorized transactions you report within 120 days
If you followed reasonable security measures
Up to account balance

raw_entities.name: Customer Security Responsibility
raw_entities.description: Customers must follow reasonable security measures to maintain FirstUK Bank's liability protection for unauthorized transactions. Failure to do so, such as sharing passwords or writing down PINs, constitutes gross negligence.
context: If you followed reasonable security measures
Gross negligence (shared password, written PIN)

raw_entities.name: Fraud Reporting Obligation
raw_entities.description: Customers must report fraudulent transactions within 120 days to maintain FirstUK Bank's liability. Failure to report fraud within this timeframe results in loss of bank liability protection.
context: Fraud you failed to report for >120 days
Unauthorized transactions you report within 120 days

raw_entities.description: FirstUK Bank is not liable for transactions that customers have authorized, regardless of whether the customer later regrets the transaction.
context: FirstUK Bank is NOT liable for: Transactions you authorized (even if regretted)

context: Fraud you failed to report for >120 days
FirstUK Bank is NOT liable for: Fraud you failed to report for >120 days
